basis: 49-scene heuristic audit without human ground truth
warning: Training role and weight are not detector accuracy estimates.
confidence_policy: Class-level weights only; Parser V1 has no reliable pixel-level confidence field.

facade.reason: Dense context is spatially useful, but 5% of scenes reach full-image coverage.

window.reason: High occurrence and bounded instance masks, with visible sign/opening confusion and high-coverage outliers.

door.reason: Median scene coverage 37.8%; p95 96.5%; oversized whole-building DINO boxes.

balcony.reason: Median coverage 45.1%; p95 96.4%; severe awning/railing confusion.

railing.reason: Localized cases exist, but p95 coverage 57.1% and strong grille/balcony overlap.

grille.reason: Fine structure unresolved; p95 scene coverage 66.7%.

awning.reason: Median coverage 35.0%; p95 96.1%; oversized sign/facade proposals and storefront confusion.

storefront.reason: Median coverage 40.0%; p95 96.2%; 95.6% overlap-over-smaller with door.

rolling_shutter.reason: Some good localized masks, but p95 coverage 69.7% and broad opening confusion.

signboard.reason: Many visually valid signs; rare catastrophic facade/grille outliers remain.

air_conditioner.reason: Small instances are often good, but p95 scene coverage 91.0% exposes catastrophic full-scene false proposals.

utility_pole.reason: Mostly sparse, but maximum scene coverage 70.3% needs human review.

wire.reason: Line heuristic responds to non-wire edges and has no instances/confidence.

vegetation.reason: Dense SegFormer context is bounded but sparse in this corpus; small plants remain inconsistent.

person.reason: Most masks are small; one catastrophic 86.2% scene outlier requires review.

vehicle.reason: Best-bounded instance class: p95 scene coverage 10.7%, maximum 13.0%, visually coherent masks.

street_object.reason: Deliberately broad class with p95 scene coverage 58.6% and catastrophic outliers.
